 EXCLUSIVE Internet FOR SUBSCRIBERS Internet Election betting odds became less accurate as primaries neared, report finds
 Online betting sites “have not yet proven consistently superior to conventional forecasters,” an analysis released Thursday said, echoing other research. Listen to this article 00:00 00:00 Predication markets have sold themselves as consistently accurate in predicting event outcomes. Leila Register / NBC News; Getty Share Add NBC News to Google Oct. 29, 2026, 6:00 AM EDT By David Ingram With midterm elections just days away, a new analysis is raising questions about the accuracy of online election prediction markets, finding that bettors were too confident about the chances of favored candidates in this year’s competitive primaries.
